context: Request: pull the right-of-first-refusal clause from Aurelius Media's lease. Rubric: matter 1017-00009 (Aurelius headquarters lease at Greystone Tower), the executed agreement-of-lease-execution.docx as proof document, and the finding that the lease grants a right of first offer, not a ROFR (Kestrel holds the ROFR).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob. The review flags that the summary treats the capped listing as the store.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists every matter folder name, the file count and per-folder counts.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for nine request and lease words (200 lines each) and two path globs; the client-name glob returns nothing. Names one candidate series with a lease agreement. The review flags lease-named files in other matters left unassessed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out with no output; a second script over four named candidates prints about 744K characters of snippets. The review flags the hand-picked scope.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide scan in matter-prefix batches for the client name and the right's name (about 66K characters), then a grep of the saved output filtered to the four candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the executed lease, its exhibit, a closing memo and a title memo of the chosen matter. The review flags that the folder was not listed.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Lists the chosen matter's files and extracts passages on the right and the senior tenant from three of its documents.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 3: reads a post-closing letter, a negotiation email and the closing checklist.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that the lease grants a different, weaker right and not the requested one, quoting the clause and citing the matter and lease.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and edits one section reference.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the response and re-extracts the quoted passages; no edit.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: adds a sentence that no lease amendment appears in the matter and re-reads.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob and a store-root file listing that prints nothing. The review advises a store-wide search.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with a broad pattern prints about 438K characters. The review flags the pattern.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide rerun times out after about 37K characters. The review flags that it covered part of the store.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 3). Extracts the clause text from the lease and exhibit of one matter. The review flags that the matter's identity was not shown.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the executed lease (three offsets), its exhibit and a closing memo.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Lists the chosen matter's files and filters them for amendment words. The review notes no document was opened.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 3: reads four negotiation and post-closing documents.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 4: re-reads parts of the lease, exhibit and closing memo and re-filters file names. The review notes the lease offset missed the clause.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that the lease grants a different right and not the requested one, quoting the clause and exhibit.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the lease section, exhibit, closing memo and response; no edit.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob. The review advises listing by matter folder.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that the lease grants a different right and not the requested one, quoting the article and citing the matter.

stages.note: Attempt 2: path check with output and one wording edit.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 3: scripts compare the quoted article word for word with the lease (one fails on the workspace path) until it matches.

divergence: All three runs pass. Each surfaced the lease matter early from file names or store-wide scans, read the executed lease and its exhibit, and wrote that the lease grants a different right than the one asked about, quoting the clause. The runs differ only in how many store-wide scans they ran before reading (two to three, several timing out or printing hundreds of thousands of characters) and in how many check passes followed. Label-check notes were ignored in two runs (folder listing and file-name searches under the store-listing label) and followed once (T2 closed an empty content-search stage and opened the extraction stage).
